note: FY2568 historical-baseline contract for procurement indicators 6.1.1/6.1.2/6.1.3 (การจัดซื้อสินค้า). Eco-product procurement facts are the frozen FY2568 baseline: assigned responsible persons, eco search sources, Form 6.1(1) product list with label/expiry/review, Form 6.1(2) procurement report (source-declared FY2568 % 92.33 volume / 89.80 value vs >40% target — not recomputed), and the 6.1.3 material survey. The FY2568 percentage and survey are permanently FY2568 facts; recurring collection must be re-done in FY2569. No FY2569 facts, no scores, no PASS claims.
